title: 2026 high-GWP F-gas refrigeration refill-ban threshold QA

sources.title: Banned F gas for refilling equipment
Calculate the carbon dioxide equivalent quantity of an F gas

facts.source_fact: Virgin F gas must not be used to refill an existing refrigeration system when both the system and gas thresholds are met.
The system threshold is 40 tonnes CO2 equivalent or more.
The gas threshold is GWP above 2,500.
The refill restriction applies to virgin or unused F gas.
Military equipment is excluded from this specific refill ban.
Equipment designed to cool products below minus 50C is excluded from this specific refill ban.
HFC404A is identified as a gas particularly affected by the refill ban.
The official table maps common gas GWPs to masses corresponding to the ban threshold.
CO2e is calculated from gas mass in metric tonnes multiplied by GWP.
The refill ban is distinct from a product-placement ban.
facts.expected_handling: Do not conflate servicing and product-market rules.
